sentiment.summary: Inflation shock and spiking Treasury yields broke the AI rally Friday, with oil surging 4% on Iran/Middle East fears and chipmakers leading a broad tech selloff.

insights.text: Inflation shock kills the AI rally. PPI came in 3x hotter than expected, spiking 10-yr yields to 4.55%—highest in a year. Chips crashed: Micron -6.6%, Nvidia -4.4%. Oil hit $105 on Iran/Strait of Hormuz fears.

Navitas at ~$21 — 2x your $10 cost, but Q1 missed. Revenue miss and wider-than-expected loss reported May 12. Pulled back from $22.65 peak. Long-term GaN/SiC story in EV and AI charging intact—hold cautiously.
ATH $133 then -5.87% Friday — still 2x your $62 cost. Q1 revenue +63.5% YoY, $2.2B backlog record, upgraded to Nasdaq Global Market. Selloff is yield-driven, not fundamental. Dip is buyable.

T1 Energy below your $6.73 cost at ~$5.50. Q1 beat expectations (+60% revenue beat) but $160M convertible notes offering weighs on shares. 2.1 GW solar fab underway—execution solid, dilution pressure real.
Seagate standout — Evercore raised PT to $1,000, Outperform. Beat Q3 estimates; AI HDD demand is structural and accelerating. Well above your $449 cost. Trail a stop — this run is legitimate.
Alphabet coils near your $390 cost — AI leverage underpriced. Cloud +63% YoY, massive AI capex committed. Friday's yield spike pressured all tech. Google I/O catalysts ahead — accumulate on dips.

Micron -6.6% Friday but up 60% in the past month. Supply shortages are driving pricing power and expanding margins. Short-term yield shock hit momentum. Structural memory supercycle intact — hold through the dip.
Microsoft at ~$420, above your $410 cost — steady compounder. Azure AI and Copilot adoption are the growth engine. Defensive tech in a volatile tape. Hold with confidence.

SanDisk up 482% YTD on structural AI NAND shortage. Record revenues driven by AI training infrastructure demand. Analysts flag cyclical risk as pricing may decelerate. Monitor closely — the bid stays strong for now.

Nebius at $208 — best performer, up 59% from your $131 cost. Nvidia invested $2B, Meta and Microsoft signed major multi-year compute deals, Eigen AI acquired for $643M. AI infrastructure thesis fully validated.
EchoStar hit $139.54 ATH May 14 — up 21% above your $114 cost. Spectrum deal value intact. Pulled back slightly Friday with broader market. Momentum strong — hold or trim into strength.

BigBear.ai at $4 — down 55% from your $9.02 cost. Defense AI pipeline building with new senior leadership hires but losses continue. No near-term catalyst visible. High risk — size accordingly or exit.

Oklo at $62 — 50% below your $125 cost basis. Down 7.4% Friday on broad risk-off. NRC approved Aurora design—real progress. Zero revenue and long wait for reactor. Speculative hold only — needs patience.
